# Operate retail (dev)

## Before deployment

The workspace, catalogues, schemas, source access and principals must exist. Resource
permissions do not grant data privileges. The deployment identity must be allowed to
manage this bundle and use the configured runner. Runner: "deployment user (development)".

Give each runner USE CATALOG / USE SCHEMA and source SELECT or READ VOLUME / external
location access as appropriate. Targets require CREATE TABLE / CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW.
Event-log schemas need write privileges; operational readers need access to their logs.
Do not grant broad rights to unrelated schemas. Serverless availability and network
access must be checked by the platform owner.

### Source and target inventory

- source.customers: source /Volumes/dev_retail/landing/source/customers; target dev_retail.current.customers; history dev_retail.history.customers.
- source.orders: source /Volumes/dev_retail/landing/source/orders; target dev_retail.current.orders; history dev_retail.history.orders.

## Promotion and monitoring

Review all generated files as one bundle and retain its state/root path across deployments.
Do not deploy two bundles to the same tables. Schedules and notification recipients come
from source configuration; change YAML and regenerate before deployment. Use native
pipeline event logs for quality/update failures and Unity Catalog for lineage. Confirm
actual alert delivery; a successfully completed update may contain no new data.
Freshness checks run only when the job runs. Central monitoring must detect missing job
starts or disabled schedules. Snapshot maximumAgeHours checks capture time; a table
freshness task checks the chosen business column. Neither proves complete source capture.

If the optional GitHub workflow is present, commit this team export at a repository root,
configure the dev GitHub Environment and DATABRICKS_CLIENT_ID variable,
and configure matching Databricks OIDC federation. The manually started workflow only
validates the bundle. It does not deploy or adopt resources. Use your existing reviewed
promotion process to deploy the exact exported commit.

## Failure and recovery

Fix a failed input/configuration and retry the native job. Empty snapshots are blocked
unless allowEmpty is explicit. Never alter accepted snapshot versions or files. Retain
an immutable producer delivery ledger and the baseline plus required deliveries. Counts
and predicates cannot detect same-count content replacement. Pipeline event logs are
execution evidence, not a source-content audit. Snapshot SCD2 boundaries are integer
versions; preserve capturedAt mapping in the delivery ledger.

Do not full-refresh after required source inputs expire. Rebuild into isolated targets
and reconcile the result/history first. Reverting code does not revert committed data.
Adoption requires the separate reviewed bind described in the root README.

## Acceptance record

Record native CLI/workspace versions, deploy and redeploy IDs, effective run identities,
operator access checks, first/update/delete results, duplicate/out-of-order handling,
failed DQ and delivery guards, received notifications, stale/no-input behaviour, retry,
and an isolated recovery comparison. Test representative data volume and cost.
Offline schema, syntax and synthetic tests do not establish any of those native results.

# retail: native Databricks ingestion

This bundle includes serverless Lakeflow pipeline resources, their source files and a job for refresh dependencies. Configure your environment values before generation. Databricks creates these project resources when you deploy; the workspace, Unity Catalog schemas, source storage, identities and data grants must already exist. No Ingestron runtime is installed.

## Resource ownership

- source: project-managed resource pipeline_source; source files are attached by the bundle.

## Pipeline source

- [pipelines/source/customers.ipynb](pipelines/source/customers.ipynb)
- [pipelines/source/orders.ipynb](pipelines/source/orders.ipynb)

## Operations and recovery

Use native pipeline event logs and Unity Catalog lineage. No Ingestron runtime is installed. Source schemas are explicit; bad schema or required values fail ingestion. Source delivery retention is an upstream responsibility; generated code does not implement archival or lifecycle deletion. Do not full-refresh after inputs have expired. History contains only observed changes; it is not a raw source archive. Repair normal failures by rerunning the native pipeline.

Snapshot delivery indexes must retain immutable IDs, versions, paths and contents. Publish them atomically after files are complete. Counts and keys are checked at runtime, but producer truth and historical completeness cannot be proven offline. Event input contains baseline rows and full-row I/U/D records with non-null ordered sequencing; conflicting equal-sequence changes must be prevented upstream.

This export resolves dev only. Generate other environments from their reviewed configuration. Offline checks do not prove native workspace execution.

dev.pipelines/sales/customers.sql:
-- Source includes baseline rows and full-row I/U/D events. Missing rows are not deletes.
CREATE OR REFRESH PRIVATE STREAMING TABLE `__sales_customers_ingest_customers_events` (
  CONSTRAINT source_schema EXPECT (_rescued_data IS NULL) ON VIOLATION FAIL UPDATE,
  CONSTRAINT operation_valid EXPECT (`operation` IN ('I', 'U', 'D')) ON VIOLATION FAIL UPDATE,
  CONSTRAINT required_0 EXPECT (`id` IS NOT NULL) ON VIOLATION FAIL UPDATE,
  CONSTRAINT required_1 EXPECT (`change_sequence` IS NOT NULL) ON VIOLATION FAIL UPDATE,
  CONSTRAINT required_2 EXPECT (`operation` = 'D' OR (`operation` IS NOT NULL)) ON VIOLATION FAIL UPDATE)
AS SELECT `id`, `name`, `change_sequence`, `operation`, _rescued_data
FROM STREAM read_files('/Volumes/dev_retail/landing/sales/customers', format => 'parquet', schema => '`id` BIGINT, `name` STRING, `change_sequence` BIGINT, `operation` STRING',
  schemaEvolutionMode => 'rescue', rescuedDataColumn => '_rescued_data');

CREATE OR REFRESH STREAMING TABLE `dev_retail`.`sales_history`.`customers`;
CREATE FLOW `apply_sales_customers_ingest_customers` AS AUTO CDC INTO `dev_retail`.`sales_history`.`customers`
FROM STREAM(`__sales_customers_ingest_customers_events`)
KEYS (`id`)
APPLY AS DELETE WHEN `operation` = 'D'
SEQUENCE BY `change_sequence`
COLUMNS * EXCEPT (`operation`, `change_sequence`, _rescued_data)
STORED AS SCD TYPE 2;

CREATE OR REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW `dev_retail`.`sales_current`.`customers` AS
SELECT `id`, `name` FROM `dev_retail`.`sales_history`.`customers` WHERE __END_AT IS NULL;
dev.pipelines/web/customers.sql:
-- Immutable input files. Lakeflow owns checkpoints; no per-run full-table copies.
-- Original-file retention is the source owner's responsibility.
CREATE OR REFRESH STREAMING TABLE `dev_retail`.`web_current`.`customers` (
  CONSTRAINT source_schema EXPECT (_rescued_data IS NULL) ON VIOLATION FAIL UPDATE,
  CONSTRAINT required_0 EXPECT (`id` IS NOT NULL) ON VIOLATION FAIL UPDATE)
AS SELECT `id`, `name`, _rescued_data
FROM STREAM read_files('/Volumes/dev_retail/landing/web/customers', format => 'parquet', schema => '`id` BIGINT, `name` STRING',
  schemaEvolutionMode => 'rescue', rescuedDataColumn => '_rescued_data');
dev.pipelines/reporting/customers.sql:
-- Domain transformation. Lakeflow resolves dataset dependencies.
CREATE OR REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW `dev_retail`.`reporting`.`customers` AS
WITH `customers` AS (SELECT * FROM `dev_retail`.`erp_current`.`customers`)
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT `id`, `name`
FROM customers
) AS result;

resources:
  jobs:
    processing:
      name: prod_retail_processing
      max_concurrent_runs: 1
      queue:
        enabled: true
      timeout_seconds: 7200
      permissions:
        - group_name: retail-operators
          level: CAN_MANAGE_RUN
      email_notifications:
        on_failure:
          - retail-operations@example.com
        on_duration_warning_threshold_exceeded:
          - retail-operations@example.com
      health:
        rules:
          - metric: RUN_DURATION_SECONDS
            op: GREATER_THAN
            value: 3600
      schedule:
        quartz_cron_expression: 0 0 6 * * ?
        timezone_id: Pacific/Auckland
        pause_status: PAUSED
      tasks:
        - task_key: refresh_erp
          pipeline_task:
            pipeline_id: ${resources.pipelines.pipeline_erp.id}
            full_refresh: false
          max_retries: 2
          min_retry_interval_millis: 120000
        - task_key: refresh_sales
          pipeline_task:
            pipeline_id: ${resources.pipelines.pipeline_sales.id}
            full_refresh: false
          max_retries: 2
          min_retry_interval_millis: 120000
        - task_key: refresh_web
          pipeline_task:
            pipeline_id: ${resources.pipelines.pipeline_web.id}
            full_refresh: false
          max_retries: 2
          min_retry_interval_millis: 120000

      service_principal_name: retail-production-runner

name: Validate Databricks bundle
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}
permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write
concurrency:
  group: bundle-retail-prod
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: prod
    env:
      DATABRICKS_HOST: https://adb-example.azuredatabricks.net
      DATABRICKS_CLIENT_ID: ${{ vars.DATABRICKS_CLIENT_ID }}
      DATABRICKS_AUTH_TYPE: github-oidc
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
      - uses: databricks/setup-cli@cfd9223558b9082c2aabb0c8fa47f1c3db2b7cbd
        with:
          version: 0.294.0
      - run: databricks bundle validate -t prod

## Operations and recovery

Use native pipeline event logs and Unity Catalog lineage. No Ingestron runtime is installed. Source schemas are explicit; bad schema or required values fail ingestion. Source delivery retention is an upstream responsibility; generated code does not implement archival or lifecycle deletion. Do not full-refresh after inputs have expired. History contains only observed changes; it is not a raw source archive. Repair normal failures by rerunning the native pipeline.

Snapshot delivery indexes must retain immutable IDs, versions, paths and contents. Publish them atomically after files are complete. Counts and keys are checked at runtime, but producer truth and historical completeness cannot be proven offline. Event input contains baseline rows and full-row I/U/D records with non-null ordered sequencing; conflicting equal-sequence changes must be prevented upstream.

This export resolves prod only. Generate other environments from their reviewed configuration. Offline checks do not prove native workspace execution.
